children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 4, 2026) - InMed Pharmaceuticals Inc.

"), a pharmaceutical company focused on developing a pipeline of proprietary small molecule drug candidates for diseases with high unmet medical needs, confirmed that, at its annual general and special meeting of shareholders held today (the "
"), the matters put forward before shareholders for consideration and approval, as set out in the Company's proxy statement/prospectus and management information circular dated October 1, 2026 (the "
"), were voted upon by the Company's shareholders. A total of 3,630,088 common shares of the Company (each, a "
"), representing approximately 66.08% of the Company's 5,493,735 issued and outstanding common shares, were represented in person or by proxy at the Meeting.
Each item of business voted on at the Meeting was approved by the shareholders. The voting results for each item of business are set out below.

Further, the Company is also pleased to announce that, following the Meeting, it has completed the previously announced consolidation of its Common Shares on the basis of one (1) post-consolidation Common Share for each ten (10) pre-consolidation Common Shares (the "
"). Per the requirements of the Business Corporations Act (British Columbia) (the "

"), if, as a result of the Consolidation, a shareholder became entitled to a fractional share, such fractional share was rounded up to the nearest whole number if 0.5 or greater and down to the nearest whole number if less than 0.5, and no cash or other consideration was paid in respect of rounding. As of November 4, 2026, immediately prior to the completion of the Consolidation, there were 5,493,735 Common Shares issued and outstanding in the capital of the Company. Following the completion of the Consolidation, there were approximately 549,374 Common Shares issued and outstanding. As a result of the Consolidation, proportionate adjustments were made to the per share exercise price and the number of Common Shares issuable upon the exercise of all outstanding stock options and warrants of the Company, and the number of Common Shares reserved for issuance under the Company's existing equity incentive plan was reduced proportionately.
Effective at the commencement of trading on November 5, 2026, the Common Shares are expected to begin trading on The Nasdaq Capital Market ("
") on a post-Consolidation basis under the Company's existing symbol "INM", with a new CUSIP number of 457637809 and a new ISIN number of CA4576378091.
The Company is also pleased to announce that, as contemplated by the Merger Agreement (as defined below), the Company has legally changed its name to Mentari Therapeutics, Inc., effective today.
In connection with the Merger (as defined below) and pursuant to a contingent value rights agreement to be entered into on or prior to the closing date of the Merger (the "
"), the Company expects to issue to shareholders of record as of the close of business on November 5, 2026 (the "

") for each outstanding Common Share held by such shareholder as of the CVR Distribution Record Date on a post-Consolidation basis, with each CVR representing the right to receive contingent payments upon the occurrence of certain events set forth in, and subject to and in accordance with the terms of, the CVR Agreement. Investors who purchase Common Shares on Thursday, November 5, 2026 are not expected to be holders of record as of the CVR Distribution Record Date. Common Shares to be issued in connection with the surrender of outstanding in-the-money stock options of the Company, as contemplated in connection with the Merger, will not entail any corresponding CVR entitlement.
Proposal No. 1 - Nasdaq Share Issuance Proposal

The approval of the Nasdaq Share Issuance Proposal approved (i) the issuance of Common Shares (including Common Shares issuable upon conversion of the Series A Non-Voting Preferred Shares of the Company), which will represent more than 20% of the Common Shares outstanding immediately prior to the First Merger (as defined below), to stockholders of Mentari Therapeutics, Inc., a Delaware corporation ("
"), pursuant to the agreement and plan of merger and reorganization dated May 19, 2026 (as amended, the "
"), among the Company, Mentari, Indigo Merger Sub Corp. ("
") and Indigo Merger Sub II, LLC ("

"), whereby, among other things, (A) First Merger Sub will merge with and into Mentari, with Mentari continuing as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company and the surviving corporation of the merger (the "
"), and (B) Mentari will merge with and into Second Merger Sub, with Second Merger Sub surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (together with the First Merger, the "
"); and (ii) the change of control of the Company resulting from the First Merger, pursuant to Nasdaq Listing Rules 5635(a) and 5635(b), respectively.
Proposal No. 2 - Return of Capital Proposal

The approval of the Return of Capital Proposal approved, via special resolution, one or more reductions of the capital of the Company in respect of the Common Shares (and, in the case of an InMed Legacy Transaction Distribution (as defined in the Circular), the InMed Preferred Shares (as defined in the Circular), if applicable) in connection with the distributions to the Company's shareholders contemplated by the Merger Agreement.

The approval of the Redomestication Proposal approved, via special resolution, the redomestication of the Company from British Columbia, Canada to the State of Nevada by continuation out of British Columbia under British Columbia law and domestication under Nevada law.
The approval of the Stock Plan Proposal approved the Mentari Therapeutics, Inc. 2026 Stock Incentive Plan.
The approval of the ESPP Proposal approved the Mentari Therapeutics, Inc. 2026 Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

The approval of the Merger Compensation Proposal approved, on an advisory basis, certain compensation arrangements for the Company's named executive officers that are based on or otherwise relate to the Merger.
The audited consolidated financial statements of the Company, together with the auditor's report thereon, for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, were received by the shareholders of the Company.

Each of the director nominees listed above was elected as a director of the Company to hold office until the next annual meeting of shareholders or until his or her successor is duly elected or appointed, unless such office is earlier vacated or such director becomes disqualified; provided that, the board of directors of the Company will be reconstituted upon completion of the Merger in accordance with the Merger Agreement.

Shareholders voted to re-appoint CBIZ CPAs P.C. as the Company's auditors for the ensuing year and to authorize the directors to fix the remuneration to be paid to the auditors; provided that, Ernst & Young, LLP is expected to be appointed for such year if the Merger is consummated.

In connection with the Meeting, the Company also solicited proxies with respect to a proposal to adjourn the Meeting, if necessary, to solicit additional proxies if there is not a sufficient number of votes in favor of the Nasdaq Share Issuance Proposal. As there were sufficient votes to approve the Nasdaq Share Issuance Proposal, an adjournment of the Meeting was determined not to be necessary.
In connection with the Meeting, the Company has filed, or will file, a report of voting results on SEDAR+ at

Consummation of the Merger is subject to the satisfaction or waiver of each of the other closing conditions set forth in the Merger Agreement. For a more complete description of the closing conditions under the Merger Agreement, please see the section titled "The Merger Agreement — Conditions to the Completion of the Merger" beginning on page 214 of the Circular.

The Company is a pharmaceutical company focused on developing a pipeline of proprietary small molecule drug candidates targeting the CB1/CB2 receptors. The Company's pipeline consists of three separate programs in the treatment of Alzheimer's, ocular and dermatological indications. For more information, visit
